title: Groups with classifiable actions on the line
summary: We motivate and study the class $\mathcal{C}$ of countable groups $G$ such that the conjugacy relation between minimal actions of $G$ on $\mathbb{R}$ by orientation-preserving homeomorphisms is smooth -- that is, admits a Borel transversal. No example of amenable group outside of $\mathcal{C}$ is known. We show a number of stability properties of $\mathcal{C}$ under group-theoretic operations and that $\mathcal{C}$ contains all finitely generated groups of piecewise affine homeomorphisms of the interval.
